newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE MANAGERS TAKE NEW POSTS IN TELEKOM SRBIJA.
newsitem.headline: OTE MANAGERS TAKE NEW POSTS IN TELEKOM SRBIJA.

text.p: A group of OTE telecom managers departed on Tuesday to assume new posts in Telekom Srbija where OTE has a 20 percent stake, OTE said in a statement.

The five managers will assume key management posts in Telekom Srbija, OTE said. Their new assignments had been agreed earlier with OTE's partner in the buyout -- Italy's Stet. Together they bought 49 percent in Serbia's telecom worth a total of 1.568 billion marks.
OTE is also eyeing an Armenian telecom bid.

On August 1, OTE's board approved a proposal by its international relations division and cleared management to submit an offer to buy 85-100 percent of Armenia's telecom Armentel. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
